1936, December
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 157 Cont.
Dec. 21
Joseph Seldat - 27 - T.B. feard - in Northvil ... Mrs. Berger - 80 - speechless but can write and asks for prayers ... Leo Francis - 58 - paraletic near 2 yrs - has wife and 3 boys .... Joseph Radimaker - 61 - cured of diabetis and stomach-cancer
Loraine Gowenlock - 20 - born blind in one eye ..... cataract devel- oped in 1921 two yrs. ago started to go total. blind - Dr. in St. Louis quite astonished.
Page 158 Dec. 26
James Russell - 48 - drinking, losing all interest in family.
Baby Wm. Paquette - 52 - spinal influenza mangitis .... in Kiefer Hospital - being enrolled perpetually ....
27 Ray Hart - 40 - T.B. about to go to Kief. Hosp. - Has wife and 4 - all seemingly threatened T.B. - Has not practiced religion in years.
Steph. Muzychka - 20 - Epileptic more or less since 3 yrs. old. Joseph Bejma - 48 - cancer of tongue and Throat. This mas was prayed for 28 of last July - See note .... Niece had him inscribed in Ser. Mass Asso'n a few days before, fearing his tongue would fall off at that time, Before the week was over he went to confession and Holy Commun- ion and inside of two weeks was back to work ........ He has neglected receiving holy Communion since and his promise to enroll perpetually. Quite a piece of his tongue fell off last week. Was here To-night - Enrold and got blessing.
(28)
Geraldine Gillies - 26 - out of employment and worrying till mentally sick - had to be put away. ...
Elizabeth Maloney - 75 - Flue. .
Fedmond Kroha - 53 - pneumonia
Page 159 Dec. 28 Anna (Mrs) Urschalitz - 54 - fears cancer operation. Has cheered others in trouble. Has grand-son born blind now four years old.
